answer: Pair-capped rewards: an agent's payout counts only trades with distinct counterparties, and any single pair may earn at most 2% of the epoch pool. A sybil ring wash-trading in circles hits that ceiling fast, so 1,000 fake nodes pass the same capped coin around. At the nadir of trust, timber-heavy real work with many partners still pays, and a beacon of public pair stats lets anyone audit the caps.
